adjudication.rationale: The diff adds Jobs::RetrieveTopic, which calls TopicRetriever#retrieve and ultimately TopicEmbed.import_remote. TopicEmbed.import_remote does `open(url).read` and `Readability::Document.new(...)` with no rescue/logging anywhere in the call chain (RetrieveTopic/TopicRetriever/TopicEmbed). Therefore network/parse exceptions (e.g., OpenURI::HTTPError, connection/timeouts, non-HTML payload issues) will bubble up and fail the job. Unlike Jobs::PollFeed which explicitly sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, RetrieveTopic has no such option in the diff, so it will use whatever the default retry behavior is, potentially causing repeated refetches for permanently bad URLs.
